# Academic Study with Abstract (6 Lines)

## Abstract
This extended abstract occupies multiple printed lines spanning across the entire width of the page. It deliberately increases the vertical footprint of the banner block to test whether projection algorithms mistakenly categorize spanning sentences as non-column blocks or interleave them with adjacent text. Rigorous spatial partitioning guarantees that such spanning headers remain unified.

## 1. Left Column Exploration
Column text starts below the spanning abstract regardless of how many lines the abstract contains.

## 2. Right Column Verification
The right column reads continuously after the entire left column has been transcribed.
